title: Krakow · Tatra Foothills and Zakopane
slogan: A 202 km loop out of Myślenice fuel
story: Mountain views, villages and traffic-aware timing. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then let the middle 81 km be the part you remember. The best part sits around Chochołów wooden village, Gubałówka view area, while Myślenice fuel and Zakopane food keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.

scenicChapters.title: Polish Tatra Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 20 km this is Polish Tatra Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
